title: SmartSubs Pro v2.9.13
notes: Security update. The speech engine now includes cryptography 49 (48.0.1 on Intel Macs), which fixes known vulnerabilities in the previous version. The risk was low, because SmartSubs only uses it for the optional Gemini features, but we recommend updating. Everything from 2.9.12 is included: the style gallery, the caption fonts installed with SmartSubs and automatic emoji.
